title: edm-stop-gate captures edm-hookify stderr with 2>&1 and discards it, swallowing every stop-event warn line and every malformed-rule-file setup error
EDM_GATEGUARD_MAX_DENIALS is unvalidated and reaches a bash arithmetic context; a non-numeric value evaluates to 0 and silently disables every denial

PreToolUse matcher "git commit" is not a tool name, so edm-lint-staged-artifacts never runs; vendor hook contract states PreToolUse matchers filter on tool name and argument filtering needs the per-handler if field
gg_is_exempt's glob_list=($globs) split also performs pathname expansion, so exempt globs are silently replaced by matching filesystem paths and stop covering the rest of the tree

audit-round-start materializes lenses to ALL_LENS_IDS without subtracting lenses_na and never checks disjointness, so --na-lenses without --lenses guarantees an irreversible partial downgrade at completion
session-start marker reconciliation removes a stale Phase-6 marker without recreating one for a genuinely active phase-6 initiative in the same run, leaving GateGuard disabled
edm-hookify validate() never type-checks enabled nor validates action, so a string "true" silently disables a rule and any non-literal 'block' action silently degrades to warn
Four unguarded jq command substitutions on the gated path abort edm-gateguard with jq's exit 5 under set -euo pipefail, outside the documented 0/1/2 exit contract and with the message suppressed
The denial budget cannot advance when session state is unwritable, so gg_maybe_deny denies every call indefinitely with no backstop, contradicting gg_mark_checked's own AC7 docstring
The EDMV4-T04 AC11 citation check iterates unquoted ls output, so a PLUGIN_ROOT containing a space makes every file skip and the check pass vacuously with zero violations

_l13_applies matches file-name markers with grep -qx (repository root only) while extension markers match at any depth, so a TypeScript monorepo with only nested tsconfig.json files is reported L13 N/A

t52_ascii_scan's non-PCRE fallback branch enforces a different predicate than the PCRE branch, also flagging ASCII control bytes, so the AC2 assertion means something different on macOS than on GNU grep
The EDMV4-T28 band asserts only a lens-file COUNT against ALL_LENS_IDS and never that the fourteen declared lens IDs are distinct and cover L1-L14
CITATION_EXEMPT_SECTIONS uses the space-joined membership idiom for an entry that itself contains spaces; correct for the one entry that exists, breaks on the second
A bare Sec."X" continuation whose CLAUDE.md prefix sits on the previous line is undetected -- documented as a known gap at the check and in decisions.md D32
Completeness check (3) can never fire for a legacy lenses:[] round_type:full record because read_round_lenses substitutes the current ALL_LENS_IDS first -- the specified AC10(a) C-4 behaviour
pattern_seed_file_for and _pattern_heading4_for have no default case arm and print nothing for an unknown audit type; unreachable because both call sites validate the enum first
An unparseable stdin payload becomes {} so not_contains conditions match vacuously and a block rule can fire on a parse failure; unreachable through either shipped consumer
timing.sh --gateguard branch 2 measures a heterogeneous sample set (one first-touch denial then nineteen already-checked allows), which is what the D34 figure actually records
With HOME unset and a root caller, edm_data_dir resolves the plugin data root to /.local/share/edm; non-root callers get the intended empty-string degradation
